info.title: AveeCare API
info.description:
The AveeCare API gives your own programs access to your agency's data in AveeCare: patients, caregivers, visits, care documentation, billing records and messages.

**Authentication.** Create an API key in AveeCare under Settings → API Keys, then send it on every request as `Authorization: Bearer ak_...`. A key acts as the person who created it: it can see and change exactly what that person can in AveeCare, in their agency only. Keys are either read-only or read & write. Keep keys on your server; never put one in a web page or mobile app.

**Pagination.** List endpoints return `{ "object": "list", "data": [...], "next_cursor": "...", "has_more": true }`. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`, with the same filters, to get the next page. `limit` is 1 to 100 (default 25). Cursors are opaque; do not build or change them.

**Errors.** Every error is `{ "error": { "type", "code", "message", "request_id" } }` with a fixed `code`: `invalid_request`, `unknown_field`, `unauthorized`, `forbidden`, `insufficient_scope`, `not_found`, `rate_limited`, `idempotency_conflict` or `internal_error`. Fields a resource does not have are refused with `unknown_field` rather than ignored.

**Retries.** Send an `Idempotency-Key` header (a UUID works well) on `POST` requests. Retrying with the same key within 24 hours returns the first result instead of creating a duplicate.

**Rate limits.** Each key may make 60 requests a minute. Every response carries `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset`; when you are over the limit you get `429` with `Retry-After`.

**Conventions.** Field names are camelCase. Times are ISO 8601 in UTC; dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`. Money is in cents. Every response has a `Request-Id` header; quote it when contacting support.

tags.name: Patients
tags.description: Patients are the clients your agency provides care to, including prospective clients you have not yet admitted.

tags.name: Contacts
tags.description: Contacts are family members and other people connected to a patient, such as an emergency contact.

tags.name: Allergies
tags.description: Allergies recorded on a patient's profile.

tags.name: Medications
tags.description: Medications on a patient's medication list, with the schedule caregivers follow when they give or assist with them.

tags.name: Care Goals
tags.description: Goals of care set for a patient, such as walking to the mailbox unaided.

tags.name: Patient Notes
tags.description: Notes your staff and caregivers keep on a patient's profile.

tags.name: Medication Administrations
tags.description: The medication administration record (MAR): each dose a caregiver gave, or the reason it was not given. Read-only.

tags.name: OASIS Assessments
tags.description: OASIS assessments recorded for Medicare home health patients. This lists each assessment and its status; the item-level answers are not included. Read-only.

tags.name: Caregivers
tags.description: Caregivers are the aides, nurses and therapists your agency schedules to visit patients.

tags.name: Caregiver Notes
tags.description: Notes your staff keep on a caregiver's profile.

tags.name: Certifications
tags.description: Certifications, licenses and background checks on a caregiver's profile, with their expiry dates.

tags.name: Availability
tags.description: When a caregiver can or cannot work. A window is either a weekly recurring time on one weekday, or a one-off date range such as time off.

tags.name: Specializations
tags.description: Skills and specialties on a caregiver's profile, such as dementia care or Hoyer lift transfers.

tags.name: Applicants
tags.description: People who applied to work for your agency, tracked through your hiring stages until they are hired as caregivers.

tags.name: Visits
tags.description: Visits are scheduled or completed caregiver shifts at a patient's home. A visit's patient, caregiver, times and status are set when it is created; reschedule or reassign a visit in AveeCare.

tags.name: Visit Notes
tags.description: Notes written about a visit by the caregiver or office staff.

tags.name: Visit Requests
tags.description: Requests from caregivers to pick up visits with a patient, which office staff approve or deny.

tags.name: Open Shifts
tags.description: Open shifts are unassigned visits offered to caregivers so one of them can claim it.

tags.name: Shift Swaps
tags.description: Requests from one caregiver to hand a visit to another, which the other caregiver and then the office approve.

tags.name: Care Plans
tags.description: Care plans describe the services a patient receives, how often, and when the plan is next reviewed. The plan's goals and task lists are managed in AveeCare and are not included here.

tags.name: Progress Notes
tags.description: Progress notes are the clinical summaries caregivers write after a visit.

tags.name: Authorizations
tags.description: Payer authorizations: how many units of a service a payer has approved for a patient, and over what dates.

tags.name: Incidents
tags.description: Incident reports: falls, injuries, medication errors and other events that need follow-up, often for regulatory reporting.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Events your agency documents about a patient, caregiver or visit, such as a complaint, a compliment or an attendance issue.

tags.name: Referral Sources
tags.description: Hospitals, physicians, case managers and other organizations that refer clients to your agency.

tags.name: Referrals
tags.description: Individual referrals of a prospective client, tracked from first contact to admission.

tags.name: Invoices
tags.description: Invoices billed to patients and their families for private-pay care. Read-only.

tags.name: Invoice Line Items
tags.description: The individual charges on an invoice. Read-only.

tags.name: Claims
tags.description: Insurance claims billed to Medicaid, Medicare and other payers, with their adjudication status. Read-only.

tags.name: Payroll Entries
tags.description: One caregiver's hours and pay for one pay period. Read-only.

tags.name: Conversations
tags.description: In-app message threads between people at your agency: one-to-one chats and named group chats. Read-only; start conversations in AveeCare.

tags.name: Messages
tags.description: Messages in a conversation. Messages you send through the API are sent as the API key's user.

tags.name: Alerts
tags.description: Alerts on your agency's alert board, such as a credential about to expire or a missed clock-in, and announcements staff post for caregivers.

tags.name: Offices
tags.description: Your agency's offices (branches). Patients, caregivers and applicants can each belong to one office. There is always exactly one default office.

tags.name: Me
tags.description: The API key making the request: its scopes, its user's role and its agency.
